verdict.rationale:
Metorial exposes a real, documented REST API (OpenAPI spec, bearer-token auth) plus TS/Python/Go SDKs covering core dev operations like sessions, providers, deployments, and tool filters, so a large share of platform functionality is API-driven. However, several UI-only workflows (generating API keys via the dashboard, configuring Workforce portals, Magic Skills governance, RBAC/SAML setup) are described only as dashboard actions with no documented API equivalent, so full UI/API parity is not evidenced.
missing for 10: API endpoints for managing portals/Workforce/Magic Skills/RBAC-SSO config, and API-based key creation instead of dashboard-only.
